scope: Seven source-code High findings; no claim of runtime or full-repository zero High
status: source repairs implemented; deployment and fresh agent review are separate acceptance steps

findings.repair: Private Door/backend key, authenticated proxy, loopback-only raw server, restricted network policy
findings.verification: Go proxy tests; real nonroot/read-only image tests; Door request and secret-provisioning tests

findings.problem: Shell expansion of repository memory filenames
findings.repair: Read Git objects through execFileSync argv and NUL-delimited filenames
findings.verification: Real Git repository containing command substitutions, quotes, spaces and newlines

findings.problem: Mutable service display name impersonates human subjects
findings.repair: Namespaced immutable registry subject; worker enforcement uses registry ID; billing self-service requires human account
findings.verification: Display-name rename/collision regression; real authentication consumers; protected worker and billing tests

findings.problem: Public bootstrap secret versions and immediate deletion
findings.repair: Remove six seeded versions without destroying existing credentials; retain 30-day recovery; document external rotation ownership honestly
findings.verification: Secret ownership policy tests and mocked GitLab Terraform plans

findings.problem: Any commenter can approve privileged agent work
findings.repair: Fail-closed live repository write-permission checks; skill approval bound to plan ID; target-repository permission check; whole-command parsing
findings.verification: Read/triage/none/unknown permissions, bot identity, unavailable lookup, stale/quoted approval and parser regression tests

findings.repair: Require existing platform membership and disable open sign-up in checked-in dev configuration
findings.verification: Production broker membership tests, allowlist parity, config regression

findings.problem: GitHub HMAC accepts public bootstrap keys
findings.repair: Reject placeholder/rotate-me/blank keys in signature verifier; resolver discards placeholders and retries provisioned value
findings.verification: Valid HMAC made with public placeholder rejected; resolver recovers when real value appears
